approved: Navin, 21 November 2026: 'Haan, BIE mein banao' (keep the best picture of each scale) and 'Ek machine, ek tasveer-set'; pictures chosen by Claude on his word ('faisla main tum par chhodta hoon')

pictures.shows: 16:9 photoreal macro of an emerald living leaf, golden sunlight, teal shaded natural background, realistic veins and translucent tissue. Sunlit patch at 60,50 leads into the leaf interior. No microscopic objects. Leave upper left open for light movement and labels.

pictures.scale: cell: mesophyll cell with chloroplasts, no proteins
pictures.shows: Scientific transparent cross-section inside the same emerald leaf patch, 16:9, soft volumetric sunlight and deep teal shadows. One mesophyll cell dominates with translucent cream wall, large clear vacuole and peripheral cytoplasm. Several realistic jade double-envelope chloroplasts; target at 64,55 with faint olive-gold internal stacks. No proteins or molecules visible. Open space above target for light animation and labels.

pictures.scale: chloroplast: grana stacks and stroma, no proteins
pictures.shows: 16:9 realistic scientific cutaway inside selected sage-green chloroplast. Double envelope surrounds ivory-teal fluid stroma and dark-green flattened thylakoid sacs stacked into grana and connected by stromal lamellae. Continuous enclosing membranes; optical transparency reveals pale turquoise lumen without physical openings. Accessible unstacked thylakoid at 64,58. No individual proteins or molecular beads at this scale. Golden light, teal depth, empty upper right for overlays.

pictures.scale: thylakoid lumen: an open thylakoid disc with a wide lumen
pictures.shows: Inside the jade chloroplast, realistic double envelope near frame edge, olive-gold stacked thylakoid discs connected by lamellae, pale mint fluid stroma between stacks. 16:9 scientific cutaway with volumetric light. Foreground thylakoid at 60,60 is a CLOSED flattened sac; transparent viewing surface reveals deep turquoise lumen without physical hole. Upper membrane clearly outlined at y45, stroma above and lumen below. No individual proteins at this scale. Clear animation spaces within lumen and above it.

pictures.scale: thylakoid membrane: closed sac with lumen, proton pump left, ATP synthase right
pictures.shows: 16:9 molecular structural cutaway of the selected closed unstacked thylakoid sac. Dark-green lipid bilayer across y60, curved sealed ends and lower sac boundary visible; pale turquoise lumen below, ivory-teal stroma above. Copper cytochrome b6f proton-translocating complex left at 22,60. ATP synthase right at 72,60 with amber membrane CF0 ring, silver stalk, violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,32 facing stroma. Transparent intact membrane, realistic structural models, golden light and teal shadows. Empty aqueous compartments for animated H+, no static molecular beads.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: CF0 channel cut open in the membrane
pictures.shows: 16:9 closer molecular cutaway inside previous ATP synthase region. Dark-green bilayer y62, pale turquoise lumen below and ivory-teal stroma above. ATP synthase remains right x72: amber CF0 ring embedded at 72,62, realistic stator-ring proton half-channels connect lumen entry 69,69 to stroma exit 78,52; silver central stalk; violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,29 facing stroma, peripheral stalk. Distinct articulated catalytic clefts, not a rotating whole head. Intact lipid field left around 38,62. Open aqueous approach space left and upper right for ADP, Pi and ATP. Golden volumetric illumination, teal shadows, no text or prepainted molecules.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: CF1 head with ADP, Pi and the turning stalk
pictures.shows: 16:9 deeper molecular structural view of the same right-hand ATP synthase x72, preserving surrounding membrane. Dark-green bilayer y64, pale turquoise lumen below, ivory-teal stroma above. Amber CF0 ring 72,64, silver rotor stalk to violet six-lobed CF1 head 72,30, peripheral stator. Show individual catalytic lobes with clearly distinct open and closed clefts and translucent local alternate domain contours indicating physical opening and closing, not whole-head spin. Empty catalytic cleft at 70,30 and product space 90,20. Left membrane region at 38,64 remains visible for subsequent inspection. Golden light, teal depth, no prepainted molecules.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: the whole machine with its twisted stalk
pictures.shows: Closer structural view of same ATP synthase centered at x72, 16:9. Olive-gold thylakoid lipid bilayer at y64, deep turquoise lumen below, pale mint stroma above. Amber CF0 ring embedded at 72,64, scientifically plausible offset proton half-channel entry and exit shown by transparent section; ivory central rotary stalk rises to violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,29, peripheral stator visible. No open aqueous hole straight through rotor center. Stroma-facing head outside lumen. Open space left for labels and above membrane for substrates. Soft volumetric molecular-model realism.

pictures.scale: ATP synthase close up: see-through CF1 head and central stalk
pictures.shows: Even closer transparent structural view of same ATP synthase, x72 maintained. Violet CF1 round head with six alternating globular lobes at 72,34 and distinct catalytic clefts, ivory central stalk through head down to amber CF0 ring at 72,76 in olive-gold bilayer. Pale mint stroma above bilayer, deep turquoise lumen below. Two neighboring catalytic lobes in different open and closed conformations as real structural states, not extra heads. Open workspace x35-58,y20-50 for substrates and x88,y35 for outgoing ATP. 16:9 realistic molecular cutaway, soft volumetric light.

pictures.scale: torn membrane: a leak beside the proton pump and ATP synthase
pictures.shows: 16:9 closer inspection within left lipid field of previous membrane, retaining right ATP synthase. Dark-green membrane y64, pale turquoise lumen below, ivory-teal stroma above. Clear aqueous tear at 38,64 with ragged lipid edges visibly connects lumen to stroma. Copper proton pump left 18,64. ATP synthase right 76,64 with amber CF0 ring, silver stalk and violet six-lobed CF1 head 76,32 facing stroma. Intact bilayer segment 51 to 65 contrasts with tear. Closed sac boundary remains visible below. Golden illumination, teal shadows, open water for H+ motion; no ATP products painted near inactive CF1.

pictures.scale: stroma: enzymes and ATP synthase inside the chloroplast
pictures.shows: Return cut to intact neighboring thylakoid membrane and stroma of same chloroplast, 16:9 photoreal molecular scientific cutaway. Olive-gold membrane at y78, deep turquoise lumen beneath, pale mint stroma fills upper field. Same ATP synthase at right x72: amber CF0 at y78, ivory stalk, violet six-lobed CF1 head at 72,55. Realistic dispersed stromal globular enzymes, recognizable Rubisco barrel at x30,y35, other individual enzyme complexes around x34,y53, NOT boxes or a wheel. Open corridors from synthase into stroma and upper left into enzyme field. Space x16,y64 for sugar product. No baked molecules, text or reaction arrows. Soft volumetric light.
